tools.name: net_salary
tools.description: Take-home pay for an employee in United Kingdom from a gross yearly salary in GBP, with 2026 rules: every tax and contribution itemised with its local name, the effective and marginal rate, employer cost and the step-by-step workings. Covers: 2026/27 rest-of-UK and Scottish bands, allowance taper ab

tools.name: gross_for_target_net
tools.description: The gross yearly salary in United Kingdom that leaves a given take-home pay, with the same situation options as net_salary. Use it to set a salary ask or check an offer.

tools.name: employer_cost
tools.description: What a salary in United Kingdom costs the employer (employer social contributions itemised), or the reverse: the gross salary a total budget allows. Give gross_annual or budget_annual.

tools.name: compare_with_netherlands
tools.description: Take-home pay of a job in United Kingdom (with the situation options of net_salary) next to a job in the Netherlands (2026, optionally with the 8% holiday allowance and the 30% ruling), in euros, with the difference a year.

tools.name: tax_rules_covered
tools.description: The United Kingdom rules the calculators apply (2026), the options they take, what is not modelled, and the official sources. Call it before answering a question the other tools may not cover.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "tax_rules_covered" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: The United Kingdom rules the calculators apply (2026), the options they take, what is not modelled, and the official sources. Call it before answering a questio…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
